newsitem.title: GERMANY: German bourse says no share price-setting possible.
newsitem.headline: German bourse says no share price-setting possible.

text.p: Germany's Deutsche Boerse stock exchange said on Monday price-setting for shares trading on the Frankfurt stock market floor was not possible due to a system crash.
The stock exchange earlier said its IBIS electronic trading systems had been interrupted due to technical problems, giving no indication of when the systems would be properly functioning again.
